import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    d = defaultdict(float)
    it = iter(sys.stdin.buffer)
    next(it, None)
    for line in it:
        p = line.rstrip(b"\r\n").split(b",")
        if len(p) < 3: continue
        d[p[1]] += float(p[2])
    out = ["%s %.2f" % (k.decode(), d[k]) for k in sorted(d)]
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))
main()
